resources.title: Delta Lake & Medallion Command Reference
resources.description: A compiled, task-organized reference for every real Delta Lake command this course teaches — creating/reading/writing tables, MERGE upserts, time travel and RESTORE, OPTIMIZE/ZORDER/VACUUM maintenance, schema enforcement and evolution, and the Autoloader ingestion pattern — all written against this course's own nyc_taxi.bronze/silver/gold tables so you can copy and adapt directly.

resources.title: Unity Catalog Governance Setup Script
resources.description: A real, runnable SQL script that stands up the nyc_taxi catalog and bronze/silver/gold schemas, creates the course's managed tables, and applies least-privilege GRANTs for three distinct real-world roles (pipeline maintainers, an analytics team, and a time-boxed contractor), plus a working column mask and row filter on silver.trips. Adapt the storage path and group names to your own workspace.

resources.title: Lakeflow Pipeline Settings Template
resources.description: A real Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline settings JSON template — catalog/schema targets, triggered vs. continuous mode, the ADVANCED edition required for expectations, cluster autoscaling, and failure notifications — with inline comments explaining what each field actually controls and why this course's own nightly medallion pipeline should stay in triggered mode.
